title: copilot --json layers
description: Output of `copilot --json layers` (cli-copilot foundation). Reports the resolved `component: cli` tier chain (from `copilot.layers.yml`, if any resolves) and per-service provenance (which tier each registered service resolves from, and whether it is a base/adopted/overridden/added service). Computed entirely CLI-side by `config/layers.py` + `services/_loader.py` -- a consumer (e.g. Control Tower) only ever renders this payload (invariant #1: parse, never compute). NOTE: this is a distinct contract from copilot-control-tower's own `layers [join]` schema, which covers department/org entitlement discovery for the content components (claude/knowledge/codex) on a different CLI program -- see that repo's docs/01-architecture/schemas/layers.schema.json. The two are unrelated verbs that happen to share a name.

schema_version.description: Contract version for this payload shape.

component.description: Which CSE component this report covers. Always 'cli' for this CLI's own `layers` command.

path.description: Absolute path to the `copilot.layers.yml` found on disk, or null if none resolves at all. May be non-null even when `cli_layers_resolved` is false (a manifest exists but has zero `component: cli` entries).

cli_layers_resolved.description: Whether a non-empty `component: cli` chain was resolved. False is the Phase-1 inert state: the CLI runs the base foundation only, byte-identical to v1.4.5.

chain.description: The resolved `cli` layer chain, highest precedence first (personal -> department -> org -> foundation). Empty when `manifest.cli_layers_resolved` is false.

services.description: Every registered `copilot <name>` service group, in registration order.

id.description: Stable layer identifier from the manifest, e.g. 'org-acme'.

role.description: Open vocabulary tier role, e.g. 'personal' | 'department' | 'org' | 'foundation'. Unknown roles are valid -- this is what keeps the model N-tier-extensible.

rank.description: Precedence of record; lower rank = higher precedence. `chain` is always pre-sorted ascending by this value.

repo.description: This layer's source repo (git URL or 'owner/name' slug).

ref.description: Git ref or semver range this layer pins to.

auth.description: SSH host alias or 'anon' this layer's sync uses -- never a credential value.

unit.description: Which department this layer serves, when `role` is 'department'; null otherwise.

tier.description: Which layer id this service currently resolves from. 'foundation' for every service in the Phase-1 inert state (no manifest).

mode.description: 'base': foundation's own service, untouched. 'adopt': a tier turned this base service on with its own config/secrets only (zero code). 'override': a tier replaced this service's command with its own implementation. 'provides': a tier added a service that does not exist in the base 12 at all.

id.description: OPTIONAL, additive. Stable slug of `name` (lowercase, non-alphanumeric runs collapsed to a single hyphen). Equal to `name` for every service today; exists so a future display-style `name` need not also be a valid identifier.

requires_secret.description: OPTIONAL, additive. Every credential NAME this service's declaring tier (`adopt`/`provides`/`override` in that tier's `cli.overlay.yml`) declared under `requires_secret`, in declaration order. Names only, never values. Empty array when the service declares none (including every base/foundation service).

store_scope.description: OPTIONAL, additive. This service's declared `store_scope` (maps to the org's `ecosystem.yml` `team_scopes`), or null when the declaring tier's overlay entry does not set one -- the common case today.

name.description: The credential name resolved via the credential ladder. Never a value.

from.description: Routing hint restricting which credential-ladder rungs are tried for this name. 'any' is the default when the overlay declares a bare string name (tries every rung).
